description:
The repository and the release inputs carry complete legal text plus a canonical changelog and a v1.0 compatibility and upgrade record.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE` contain the complete texts matching the `MIT OR Apache-2.0` manifest expression, and both are included in the published native archive.
- [hard] REQ-02: The changelog and the v1.0 release-note source state the supported capabilities, compatibility boundaries, upgrade expectations, and intentional packaging removals, without repeating installation commands.
- [hard] REQ-03: A release metadata check fails when either license text, the v1.0 changelog entry, or the compatibility and upgrade record is missing or names a version other than the declared product version.

## Notes

Blast radius: repository-root license and changelog files, the canonical release-note source, and release metadata validation; installation and deployment commands remain in the canonical user guides.
title: Add the dual-license and compatibility release record
